goal: Reduce macOS release binary download sizes and disk footprint
Removes duplicate compiled functions to cut Darwin binary sizes by about five percent
reviewability: Ready for review, though the author has promised an update addressing Darwin flag issues
agreement: Support for Darwin binary size savings of roughly five percent (davidgumberg)
Concept approval for using identical code folding linker features (hebasto)
Unaddressed objection: Mach-O LLD folds address-taken functions without -faddrsig (151henry151)
Contested objection: safe folding on Mach-O requires address tables to preserve identity (Sjors)
Nonblocking objection: probe order causes safe flags to override safe_thunks (hebasto)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because shrinking macOS binary sizes is a modest and deferrable optimization
Offers minor download and disk savings without affecting functionality
